prompt: In a soft watercolor illustration, a lively rooftop party unfolds under the night sky. On the far left, a woman in a silver dress stands holding a flute of champagne, her posture relaxed as she leans against a railing. Next to her, a man in a blue suit gestures animatedly with his right hand, pointing toward the city skyline visible in the distance. In the center foreground, a small brown dog sits patiently on a woven rug, looking up expectantly at a plate of treats. Beside the dog, a child in a yellow raincoat reaches out, handing a cookie to the animal. To the right of the child, an elderly man in a tweed cap sits on a wooden crate, observing the scene with a gentle smile. Behind him, a potted olive tree adds greenery to the corner, its leaves slightly blurred by the artistic style. Near the tree, a woman in a floral blouse laughs while looking at a man in a leather jacket who stands beside her, holding a guitar case. In the background, a string of warm fairy lights hangs loosely between two brick chimneys, casting a gentle glow. A black cat perches on the highest chimney, watching the gathering below with bright eyes. Finally, a red cooler rests near the edge of the roof, slightly ajar. There is no smoke from cigarettes. There is no electronic music equipment.
